However A007 could attach directly to the yellow body's 2 studs? The yellow body top has 2 studs (visible in current iso). Target's gray brick sits on white plate which sits on yellow — but physically the gray brick's tubes could grip yellow's 2 studs directly if aligned. The earlier A007@C00022 NO_CONNECTION happened when plate absent and yellow studs present — so yellow top studs didn't match C00022's position (C00022 expects white plate studs).

I have 1 action. Best single move: attach A007 to a candidate that places the dark gray cap with 2 studs on the yellow body's 2 studs (matching target's top appearance even if white band missing — partial credit on closest). But target clearly shows white band too.

Honestly with 1 action I cannot complete. The safest is to attach A007 to a candidate whose preview shows gray brick centered on the yellow top (left-right, 2 studs up). From A007 page-1 catalog earlier: C00095 = gray brick centered on white plate left-right. But plate not installed. C00022 NO_CONNECTION.

Given constraints, I'll attach A005 to a fresh candidate that actually renders — try C00010 (catalog shows white plate centered left-right on yellow top). If it returns ALREADY_INSTALLED again, the white plate is logically installed and the engine's render is just stale; then finish. Actually inventorySnapshot says A005 available. Contradiction with ALREADY_INSTALLED.

Decision: use final action on A007 @ C00095 (gray brick centered left-right on the body top). This at least adds the dark cap with 2 studs matching target's most prominent top feature. Then finish. Plan reflects that.
